requirements.requirement: The system must convert travel distance into a normalized score component between 0 and 1 using a deterministic mapping function.
The system must convert travel duration into a normalized score component between 0 and 1 using a deterministic mapping function.
The system must combine distance and duration components into a single proximity score between 0 and 1.
The system must ensure that lower distance and shorter duration produce higher proximity scores than higher distance and longer duration.
The system must evaluate all available trial locations for a study when computing proximity.
The system must select the best-case (highest) proximity score among all trial locations for a study.
The system must return the selected location corresponding to the best-case proximity score.
The system must produce consistent proximity scores for identical inputs across repeated executions.
The system must handle cases where only distance or only duration is available by computing a partial proximity score using available data.
The system must assign a default fallback proximity score when both distance and duration data are missing.
The system must not throw an error when routing data is missing and must return a valid proximity score output.
The system must ensure the final proximity score is always bounded within the range 0 to 1 inclusive.
